owns: Reproduction quality and exact-version/environment capture.
Regression-test design for observed behavior and failures.
Boundary, state-transition, input-event, retry, and failure-path probing.
Evidence classification and truth boundaries for QA claims.
Detection of contradictions between accepted behavior, tests, and candidate behavior.
QA risk handoffs and explicit HOLD recommendations when evidence is insufficient.
does_not_own: Product identity, feature direction, business priority, or roadmap authority.
Final game balance or systems-design decisions.
Gameplay feel tuning except as observed evidence supplied to Gameplay.
Visual/art direction except as observed evidence supplied to Experience or Design.
Security acceptance, legal interpretation, or other specialist domains merely because a test can touch them.
Changing implementation solely so an existing test becomes green.
escalates_when: Expected behavior is ambiguous, contradictory, or not grounded in accepted state.
A candidate intentionally changes an accepted contract and the owning profession has not resolved the new expectation.
A suspected safety, security, legal, privacy, or data-loss issue crosses QA ownership.
The available environment cannot reproduce the relevant execution surface honestly.
A failure appears to originate in the test harness rather than the product.

owns: Dependency ordering and exact composition mechanics.

Exact-candidate structural/build/package verification and integration evidence.
Release candidate identity, rollback continuity, and accepted-state synchronization.
does_not_own: Product identity, feature direction, game/system rules, UX/art decisions, security acceptance, legal interpretation, or business priority.
Changing another profession's accepted expectation merely to make composition easy.
Calling a candidate professionally correct because Git reports it mergeable or CI is green.
escalates_when: Two changes encode contradictory domain expectations.
A candidate cannot be verified on its exact composition.
Landing would overwrite newer accepted state or lose provenance.
Release or migration cannot be rolled back or otherwise recovered within the declared continuity contract.
Security, privacy, legal, safety, or other specialist acceptance is required beyond integration evidence.

LOD, batching, texture/material budget evidence and artist-facing tooling within accepted targets.
does_not_own: Final aesthetic direction, engine architecture, gameplay rules, source-art authorship or target-device performance certification.
Calling a technically valid import visually good or gameplay-ready without adjacent evidence.
escalates_when: Optimization materially changes silhouette, readability, deformation or authored intent.
Engine/runtime constraints require architecture changes or target-device evidence is missing.
